item.title: EU cyber rules put crypto wallet makers on 24-hour reporting clock
item.description: Crypto wallet providers must submit an early vulnerability report within 24 hours and a full notification within 72 hours of exploits, or risk administrative fines of as much as $17.3 million.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: CLARITY Act vote meets Fed rate hike: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
item.description: Bitcoin traders brace for volatility as the CLARITY Act awaits a Senate vote to move forward and the Fed is due to announce its latest rate decision.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Symbiosis says recovered 15 BTC from bridge hack, offers 20% bounty
item.description: Symbiosis is offering a 20% bounty for information leading to asset recovery after the hacker refused to return the stolen funds for the same white-hat bounty.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: UK FCA seeks views on fund rule exemptions for tokenized gold
item.description: The FCA said uncertainty over whether some tokenized gold products fall under UK fund rules could affect adoption and investor access.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $463M in weekly reversal as Ether ETFs gain $197M
item.description: ARKB, GBTC and IBIT led Bitcoin ETF withdrawals, while BlackRock’s ETHA pushed Ether ETFs into weekly inflows.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: King Charles to host AI chiefs amid industry call to slow development
item.description: The gathering comes days after Dario Amodei and Sam Altman called for greater restraint at the AI frontier, warning that rapidly improving systems could pose increasingly difficult-to-control risks.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Robinhood CEO says issuers should not have veto over tokenized stocks
item.description: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev said issuers should be involved if tokenized products change shareholder rights or company obligations, but not when they create separate instruments backed by shares.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: US Republicans send ‘final’ CLARITY Act offer to Democrats
item.description: The 635-page revised proposal includes Trump-backed ethics provisions and comes just two days before a key procedural vote.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Revolut attackers threaten daily customer data leaks
item.description: Attackers reportedly published identity documents and selfies belonging to Revolut customers and threatened to release more data each day until the fintech pays.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Crypto’s biggest week ever? Swarm fears prompt AI slowdown: Hodler’s Digest
item.description: Crypto’s moment of CLARITY finally arrives with a key Senate vote on Tuesday. AI swarm fears prompt development slowdown, with some predicting big falls in AI stock prices.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Anthropic chief urges slowdown in AI development to safer pace
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman agrees with safety concerns regarding AI development, says no initial share sale this year.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Revolut says customer data exposed through fake government email
item.description: Passports, selfies and financial transaction histories of some customers were revealed to a fraudster using a government agency domain.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: North Korea using foreign talent to help infiltrate US companies: Report
item.description: The DPRK has turned to third-country IT workers to pass job interviews, after which, the positions are usually taken over by North Korean operatives.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Farage’s Reform UK gets $97M from two crypto billionaires
item.description: Ben Delo, co-founder of BitMEX, donated almost $50 million to Nigel Farage’s Reform UK party, matched a day later by Christopher Harborne.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Nvidia considers $10B investment in potential record Anthropic IPO: Reuters
item.description: Anthropic is said to be seeking to raise as much as $100 billion in the offering, which could value the AI company at about $2 trillion.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Bitcoin Suisse to shift up to half of Swiss jobs abroad
item.description: The Swiss crypto financial services firm plans to move back-office functions to lower-cost international hubs as it expands its global wealth and asset management business, according to Finews.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Hyperliquid’s biggest risk is regulation, says Ran Neuner
item.description: The Crypto Banter founder said Hyperliquid’s network effects give it a strong competitive moat, but regulatory uncertainty remains its biggest threat.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Anchorage Digital adds institutional access to Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin
item.description: The US federally chartered crypto bank will allow institutional clients to hold, mint, redeem and stake Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin through its custody platform.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin spikes toward $80K as US CPI data delivers new 22-year high in bond yields
item.description: Bitcoin briefly rebounded past $79,000 and US stocks turned green as US CPI inflation data met expectations.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Metaplanet cuts Series 10 stock pool by 41%, plans Hong Kong subsidiary
item.description: Metaplanet will cut 131.3 million potential shares and form a $1 million Hong Kong subsidiary for trading in Bitcoin, equities and credit products.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Trading stocks against BONER is the latest trend for DeFi degens
item.description: Why would anyone want to trade a healthcare stock for a memecoin like BONER? Why wouldn’t they, ask the degens on Robinhood Chain who are building a strange new corner of DeFi.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows accelerate as investors pull $449M in three days
item.description: ARK 21Shares accounted for $164 million of Thursday’s Bitcoin ETF withdrawals, while Ether and Solana funds also recorded net outflows.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Robinhood’s crypto volume increases 61% in August, still down 38% YoY
item.description: Bitstamp accounted for $10.1 billion of Robinhood’s August crypto volume, while trading on the Robinhood app fell 46% from a year earlier.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: UniCredit seeks infrastructure partner for crypto trading, custody: Report
item.description: The Italian bank is reportedly seeking assistance in launching access to crypto trading, custody and tokenized investment products.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin buyers wary of July sub-$58K floor amid onchain data ‘anomaly’
item.description: Bitcoin HODL waves data revealed an unusually muted reaction to Bitcoin’s drop below $58,000, raising questions over its status as a bear-market floor.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Standard Chartered forecasts SKY rising fivefold to $0.325 by 2028
item.description: The bank expects Sky to pass five times as much value to token holders by 2028 as USDS adoption and borrowing capacity continue to expand.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: India launches tokenized bond pilot with $107M issued
item.description: SEBI said later phases of Demat 2.0 will introduce secondary trading and open the tokenized bonds to retail investors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Anthropic says Claude used for cyberattacks and surveillance
item.description: A Russian-speaking operator targeted more than 20 organizations, while a Mali consultant used Claude to build a mass-surveillance platform.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Blockstream rejects ransom as Liquid hackers hold nearly 600 BTC
item.description: Blockstream said it would work with law enforcement, exchanges and forensic specialists to recover the Bitcoin if the hackers do not return it.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
